messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] sev2: increased latency and 5xxs on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — estimated ~12% of requests affected. Pager routed to @paul (oncall)
paul: ack. I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking recent deploys :mag:
incidents-bot: recent deploy to serving-cluster-a at 10:05 UTC (image=redwood-v2.2-canary)
alex: rolling back the canary now to v2.1 to stop the spike. running: `rdctl deploy rollback --cluster serving-cluster-a --image redwood-v2.1`
jamie: noted. can someone estimate customer impact while mitigation proceeds? I need that for customer comms and credits.
sara: quick read: 3 customers show sustained 500s and retries, one is a high-throughput SSO tenant. rough-> 8k failed requests in 7m window, likely retry storms causing extra load.
paul: rollback complete at 10:12 UTC. preliminary metrics look back to baseline, error rate down to normal.
alex: adding KV-cache metrics — saw cache miss rate spike coincident with autoscaler flapping after canary. suspect autoscale thresholds caused pod churn + cold KV caches.
jamie: ok, next steps: schedule postmortem, create action items (owner, size, severity), draft customer comms + credits.
mira: let's schedule the postmortem for Tue 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC. I'll create the doc and calendar invite. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/3051234567
sara: proposed action items (quick list):
  - tighten autoscale threshold + add unit/integration tests (owner=alex, estimate=3 pts, severity=SEV2)
  - add deploy guard that prevents canary autoscale config changes during rollout (owner=jamie, estimate=5 pts, severity=SEV1)
  - kv-cache warmup on scale-up (owner=alex, estimate=2 pts, severity=SEV2)
  - customer credits + comms (owner=sara, estimate=1 pt, severity=SEV2)
jamie: I'll open GH issues for each and tag with `postmortem:3051234567` and `priority:quarterly` where appropriate. suggest we treat the deploy guard as P0 for next sprint given customer-visible errors.
paul: agree. mark deploy-guard SEV1 -> schedule into next sprint planning. autoscale tuning + cache warmup go into remediation backlog for Q2 work if not urgent.
sara: rough credit ask: 10k credits across the three affected customers; will confirm amounts and legal review.
alex: I'll attach relevant logs and the `rdctl` rollout timeline to the postmortem doc before EOD.
mira: created calendar invite and postmortem doc, added owners. action tracker board: https://board.internal/3051234567
jamie: owners, please add acceptance criteria to the GH issues (tests, monitoring alerts, smoke test steps). also add a regression test that simulates autoscale churn.
paul: oncall will follow up in the postmortem to confirm monitoring alerts fired and that runbooks are updated.
sara: once comms approved, I'll send customer emails and apply credits via billing.
alex: thanks everyone — closing this live thread now. we'll reconvene at the postmortem. :thumbsup:
